description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kadndaliyaddapaluwa, D/S Division,Mahara, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.510811 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and owner details) in various villages. The content focuses entirely on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
